3D environment sourcing and production

The character archive is not a 3D environment pack.

On this page
Required production assetsBuild one environment moduleFoliage/resourcesRelease restriction

Required production assets

Terrain/landscape materials, roads, stairs, bridges, buildings/interiors, tree and ore meshes, water/shore materials, props, collision, audio and enemy/NPC sprite families need separate licensed acquisition or original authoring. Maintain creator/license/version/source-path and permitted redistribution for each source. Do not label graybox primitives as finished world assets.

Build one environment module

  1. Write the zone art brief from world catalog: scale, climate/palette, camera readability and gameplay route.
  2. Graybox route in centimeters using simple collision. Validate jump/step/swim/LOS/navmesh and travel times before detail.
  3. Create or license a small modular kit with pivots, grid snapping, simple collision, material slots and LODs appropriate to the target hardware.
  4. Replace one section while preserving gameplay bounds/IDs. Avoid decorative collision blocking roads or resource approaches.
  5. Evaluate sprite contrast in daylight/night/rain and under canopy; author local occluder masks where needed.
  6. Measure render cost, memory, streaming transitions and server navigation; register sources and rights. Expand the kit only after this section passes.

Foliage/resources

Visual trees are not automatically harvestable resource nodes. A selected eligible site spawns or activates a node with durable SiteId/generation and interaction approach. Decorative foliage can remain static and noninteractive; avoid one expensive replicated Actor per blade of grass. Resource depletion may swap/hide a visual but must not silently remove a structural bridge/tree needed for traversal.

Release restriction

Keep third-party source assets private unless their license explicitly permits redistribution in source form. A packaged-game use license does not necessarily permit a public documentation repository to host the PNG/mesh. This package includes descriptions only.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
